items.summary: Fix the Dashboard loading/activation logic so the dashboard never stays stuck in a loading state when the test list API call fails in the frontend. The UI must stop showing the loading skeleton/spinner once the tests query settles (success OR error), and must show a clear error message with a retry action when tests cannot be loaded.

Fix the mobile menu transparency/blank-background issue by ensuring the Sheet (mobile menu) always renders with a full-screen dimmed overlay/backdrop behind it and correct stacking order. Add a proper overlay element or global CSS overrides so the overlay covers the viewport (inset-0), has a dark semi-transparent background, and sits behind the menu panel but above page content.

Prevent recurrence of the mobile menu rendering issue by hardening the open/close lifecycle: ensure the mobile Sheet state is reset on navigation and when view activation starts, and ensure no intermediate visual state remains if view activation triggers while the menu is open.
